summary: Primary TOP for rendering 3D scenes. It needs at least a Camera COMP and Geometry COMP, with materials assigned on the geometry, and can output normal color renders, multiple cameras, depth/extra color buffers, UV unwraps, cube maps, transparency peels, GLSL MAT vectors/samplers, and image outputs for downstream TOP compositing.

key_concepts: Order Independent Transparency disables Multi-Camera rendering
common_gotchas: A Render TOP needs a Camera object, a Geometry object, and a Material on the Geometry COMP as the minimum useful render setup; missing any one of these is a common black-render cause.
The Geometry and Lights parameters support Pattern Matching, so patterns like geo* ^geo7 can intentionally include many objects while excluding one by name.
Multi-Camera rendering is fastest when cameras can share a pass, but differing Camera Light Mask results can force one pass per camera.
Depth Peeling or Order Independent Transparency disables Multi-Camera rendering, so do not combine those features expecting the same multi-camera speedup.

The crop parameters modify the projection matrix without changing texture resolution; keep the Render TOP aspect aligned with the real overall output or the cropped projection will stretch incorrectly.
Images page outputs are declared for GLSL MATs by the Render TOP and are retrieved after the render with Render Select TOP; do not declare those image uniforms manually in the GLSL MAT itself.
Color Output Needed can be turned off for depth/prepass workflows, but that intentionally avoids copying the color result to the TOP texture.
Higher Anti-Alias settings consume more graphics memory, so verify gpu_memory_used with an Info CHOP when increasing render quality.
